meta.name: opencode-qa
meta.description: QA opencode itself, per case: verify the CLI/terminal (opencode run, db, serve, export), prove a specific plugin hook/action/event fired via the SSE event stream, smoke-test the TUI under tmux, and investigate sessions in opencode's SQLite DB by id, title/name, or message text. Ships tested helper scripts (each with a --self-test) plus per-domain references. Use whenever someone wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug opencode's CLI, HTTP server, plugin hooks/events, or TUI, or to find/inspect opencode sessions in the database. Triggers: opencode qa, qa opencode, test opencode, verify opencode hook, opencode session db, find opencode session by id/name/text, opencode tui test, opencode server health, opencode event stream.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证 AI 编程助手的命令、界面与数据记录是否正常
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要验证 opencode 的命令、插件触发及会话数据是否正常
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on or use an AI coding assistant and need to verify its CLI, plugin events, or session history

howto.what: 装上后,你可以让 Claude 帮你检查 opencode(一个 AI 编码工具)本身是否正常。它能运行自带的测试脚本来验证命令行、界面、插件事件是否工作,也能按 ID、标题或消息内容查找 opencode 的会话记录,或导出整段会话为 JSON 文件。
howto.when: 当你想测试、验证或排查 opencode 的命令行、HTTP 服务、插件事件等,或按 ID、标题或消息文本查找它的数据库会话时触发。

say.text: 检查 opencode 的命令行是否正常,让它列出 src 目录下的文件
say.note: 这会以非交互方式运行 opencode,并输出结构化事件。

say.text: 验证 opencode 的服务器健康并监听一个事件
say.note: 脚本会连接 HTTP 服务并等待事件流中的指定事件。

say.text: 在 opencode 数据库里查找标题含‘登录’的最近会话
say.note: 按标题只读查询会话列表,不改动任何数据。

howto.what_en: With it, Claude can QA opencode itself: run bundled self-tests to verify CLI, TUI, and plugin events; find sessions by ID/title/message in the SQLite DB; export a session as JSON.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug opencode's CLI, HTTP server, plugin events, or TUI, or to find/inspect sessions in its database.

say_en.text: Check the opencode CLI works by listing files in src.
say_en.note: Runs opencode non-interactively and streams structured events.

say_en.text: Verify the opencode server health and watch for an event.
say_en.note: Connects to the HTTP server and waits for a specific event.

say_en.text: Find recent opencode sessions whose title contains 'login'.
say_en.note: Reads sessions by title only; does not modify data.
